name: signal_iscola
setup: w = hann(64, 'periodic'); w2 = hamming(64, 'periodic'); wr = ones(1, 64);
expr: [tf1, m1, d1] = iscola(w, 32, 'ola'); [tf2, m2, d2] = iscola(w, 32, 'wola'); [tf3, m3, d3] = iscola(w, 32); [tf4, m4, d4] = iscola(w2, 32, 'ola'); [tf5, m5, d5] = iscola(wr, 0, 'ola'); [tf6, m6, d6] = iscola(w, 31, 'ola'); [tf7, m7, d7] = iscola(w, 48, 'ola'); tfs = iscola(w, 32, 'ola');
comment: MATLAB Signal Toolbox iscola — Constant OverLap-Add compliance check. Sums (possibly squared) window shifted by hop = M - noverlap in the stable overlap region; tf = 1 iff maxDev ≤ |m| · eps. Default method 'wola' (sum of w²). Hann 50% overlap: COLA under 'ola' (m=1), not 'wola' (m=0.75, dev=0.25). Hamming 50%: COLA under 'ola' (m=1.08). Rectangular hop=M: trivially COLA (m=1). Hann 75% overlap: m=2 under 'ola'. Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b on 8 probed cases. Octave 11.1.0 ships iscola in the signal package (not core), reports N/A there.
